response.original_title: The Wind that Shakes the FilmSoc
response.overview: Young and restless Adam finds himself being placed in the middle of a heist with his good friend Daniel, embracing his alter ego The Guv'na.  Through the guv'na's ragtag team of heisters, consisting of famous lockpick Mick the Pick, and famed tallman Frankie Long Legs, the crew attempts to steal the DU filmsoc 48 hour film festival award. Adam soons discovers the shortcomings of the crew, and after giving up on stealing the award, they come up with a solution to win the award in a completely unexpected way.
response.title: The Wind that Shakes the FilmSoc
